result:
I plotted monthly revenue from `data/sales.csv` as a bar chart and saved it as `design notes/monthly-revenue.png`, next to `login flow.png`. The image is displayed above.

Revenue grows from $41.2k in January to $71.8k in December. The only dips are February and June, plus a small one in October.

The CSV already has a row for December 2026, but today is Nov 28, so that bar is probably a forecast or placeholder. I plotted it as given. If it isn't actual revenue, I can drop it or mark it as projected.
